query:
INSERT INTO resolved_receivables (receivableId, maxiprodId, cliente, valorOriginal, valorAReceber, vencimentoData, documento, empresa, vendedor, diasAtrasoNaResolucao, statusCobranca, totalContatos, resolvedAt)
SELECT 
  ar.id as receivableId,
  ar.maxiprodId,
  ar.cliente,
  ar.valorLiquido as valorOriginal,
  CAST(CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(ar.valorRecebidoLiquido, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS CHAR) as valorAReceber,
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(ar.vencimentoData, 'T', 1) as vencimentoData,
  ar.documentoVinculadoNumero as documento,
  ar.empresaNome as empresa,
  NULL as vendedor,
  DATEDIFF(ar.liquidacaoData, ar.vencimentoData) as diasAtrasoNaResolucao,
  COALESCE(cp.status, 'pendente') as statusCobranca,
  0 as totalContatos,
  ar.liquidacaoData as resolvedAt
FROM accounts_receivable ar
LEFT JOIN cobranca_planilha cp ON cp.ar_id = ar.id
WHERE ar.estado = 'RECEBIDO'
  AND ar.liquidacaoData >= '2026-05-15'
  AND DATEDIFF(ar.liquidacaoData, ar.vencimentoData) >= 3
  AND ar.id NOT IN (SELECT receivableId FROM resolved_receivables);
